statement: The function returns a result r, and: (a) if there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] < k, then r = -1; (b) if nums[i] >= k for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), then r equals the number of distinct integers v such that v > k and v = nums[i] for some index i with 0 <= i < len(nums).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result (it does not fail, panic, or overflow).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r: r != -1 if and only if there exists a finite sequence of operations (each operation choosing an integer h such that all current array values strictly greater than h are equal to each other, then replacing every current value strictly greater than h by h) after which every element of the array equals k.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r: -1 <= r and r <= len(nums).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r: r = 0 if and only if nums[i] = k for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r: r = 1 if and only if (i) nums[i] >= k for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), and (ii) the set of values {nums[i] : 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] > k} is nonempty and all of its elements are equal to one another.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: If there exists an integer v such that nums[i] = v for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), then whenever the function returns a result r: r = 0 if v = k, r = 1 if v > k, and r = -1 if v < k.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: For every slice nums2 that also satisfies the preconditions (with the same k) and is a permutation of nums (i.e. every integer occurs the same number of times in nums2 as in nums), the function returns the same result on (nums2, k) as on (nums, k).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: For any two slices a and b satisfying the preconditions (with the same k) such that a[i] >= k for every index i of a, b[i] >= k for every index i of b, and for every integer v > k, v occurs in a if and only if v occurs in b, the function returns the same result on (a, k) as on (b, k).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: If the function returns r on (nums, k) and returns r1 on (nums, k1), then r != -1, r1 != -1, and r1 >= r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100; additionally 1 <= k1 <= k and nums[i] >= k for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, r is the minimum length of a sequence of operations (each operation choosing an integer h such that all current array values strictly greater than h are equal to each other, then replacing every current value strictly greater than h by h) that transforms nums into an array all of whose elements equal k: a sequence of length r exists, and no sequence of length less than r exists.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, r <= 100 - k.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: For every slice nums2 satisfying the preconditions and obtained from nums by deleting every element equal to k while keeping the relative order of the remaining elements, if len(nums2) >= 1 then the function returns the same result on (nums2, k) as on (nums, k).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns the result -1, there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] < k.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100, and 1 <= k <= 100.
